Container.Name: watermarks-remover
Container.Overview:
HTTP service behind the watermarks-remover Claude skills (remove-ai-marks). Strips AI provenance marks from files: invisible Unicode in text, and C2PA / EXIF / XMP / container metadata on PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, SVG, PDF, DOCX, ODT, EPUB, HTML and Markdown. The skill POSTs base64 payloads to /clean, /inspect and /detect; check /health and /capabilities.
Stateless: no volumes, no database. Runs read-only with a tmpfs /tmp as a non-root user (10001). No API key by default - set WATERMARKS_SERVER_API_KEY to require a Bearer token (fine to leave empty on a LAN that is not exposed).
The heavy pixel-domain backends (CtrlRegen, MarkDiffusion, SynthID scorer) are NOT in this image by upstream design (non-redistributable licenses); /capabilities reports them absent and the skill will not offer pixel removal.
Client side: the skill reads WATERMARKS_SERVICE_URL, e.g. http://10.47.40.43:8765 - see remove-ai-marks SKILL.md.

Config.Name: Service Port
Config.Description: HTTP port of the cleaning service (health check at /health, JSON API at /clean, /inspect, /detect, /capabilities).

Config.Name: API key (optional)
Config.Description: Leave empty for no auth (LAN-only). If set, every request must send 'Authorization: Bearer <this key>' - and the skill's client must be given the same value.

Config.Name: SynthID scorer URL (optional)
Config.Description: URL of a separately-run reverse-SynthID scorer sidecar (heavy profile, not published to GHCR - build locally if you ever want it).

Config.Name: SynthID scorer API key
Config.Description: Bearer key for the scorer sidecar, if one is configured.
